description: Use this when someone asks whether one specific GTA 6 claim is confirmed (use get_facts to browse the whole database instead). Looks the claim up and returns the closest entries with their status (confirmed, reported or not-announced), the reason and the source. A status describes the entry as written, not the claim in the question. Returns no match rather than guessing when nothing is close.

claim.description: The claim in plain words, for example "GTA 6 is coming to PC at launch"

name: check_claim
title: Check a GTA 6 claim
